_comment: Code Verdict — reference payloads for the shapes in 'Code Verdict — developer handoff.md'. Trimmed to the fields the extension reads. Build against these; they match the prototype's demo data.

agentReviewResponse._comment: What a Copilot review agent must return for MR !2841. The extension validates this shape and rejects items missing file/line/severity/category/confidence. `candidates` are findings the agent produced that fell below the pod criteria — they are NOT shown as items, but they power the 'no findings above your criteria' screen.

criteria.extraInstructions: Terse. No praise. Cite the rule or CVE class. Ignore formatting — Prettier owns it.

items.title: Refresh token logged in error path
items.body: Secret material reaches the log sink. Log shipping is not scrubbed, so the token lands in retained storage. Redact, or log only the token id.

answers.explain: The logger writes to stdout, which the runner ships to a 90-day retained index. A leaked refresh token is a full account takeover until rotation.
answers.fix: Log the opaque token id, never the token. The suggestion is line-accurate for GitLab.
answers.similar: Two other sites log raw credentials: src/api/client.ts:118 and src/ui/session.tsx:44.
answers.why: Matched rule secrets/no-credential-logging plus taint flow from this.refreshToken to a sink.

items.title: Race on concurrent refresh calls
items.body: Two callers can clear the guard before it is set, issuing two refreshes and invalidating the first token. Store the in-flight promise and return it.

answers.explain: The guard is read and written in separate microtasks; both callers see false. Under a 401 storm every request refreshes.
answers.fix: Assign this.pending before the first await and return it for subsequent callers.
answers.why: Interleaving detected across two await points on shared mutable state.

items.title: Missing test for 401 → refresh path
items.body: The new interceptor branch is untested. One case asserting a single refresh and one replay would cover both blockers above.

answers.explain: Coverage on token.ts dropped from 91% to 68% in this MR; the new branch is the gap.
answers.fix: Add a case that queues two parallel 401s and asserts exactly one POST /oauth/token.
answers.similar: test/api.spec.ts:88 has a mock harness you can copy.
answers.why: New conditional branches with no corresponding assertions in the diff.

postSummaryRequest.body:
**Reviewed with HVE Core / PR Review.** 2 blockers: refresh token logged in error path (token.ts:63); race on concurrent refresh calls (token.ts:88). Needs a fix before merge. 5 smaller items posted inline. 3 findings dismissed as false positives.

Both blockers must be fixed before merge. The minor items can land in a follow-up MR — open an issue and link it here.

discussionsResponse._comment: GET /projects/:id/merge_requests/:iid/discussions — polled to derive thread status. Mapping: no notes after yours → awaiting; last note not yours → replied; resolved:true → resolved; position:null on a text discussion → stale (anchor dropped by a force-push).

notes.body: **Refresh token logged in error path** · blocker · security · CWE-532 …
The shipper scrubs secrets in prod, doesn't it? I'd rather keep the full token for local debugging.

Gate the debug banner on NODE_ENV, not a query param.

changeset._comment: A detected changeset: MRs across projects that ship together. Detection runs over the pod's open MRs; a detected group is a suggestion until the user opens it.

crossRepoItem._comment: A finding that cannot be produced by a single-repo review. Requires the agent to receive every member diff in one request. `spans` names each side and its role; `mrIid` is where the comment gets posted.
crossRepoItem.title: Response field renamed in the gateway but still read in the console
crossRepoItem.body: The gateway renames the field in !381 while the console still reads session.expiry in !1509. Both merge green on their own and the session banner breaks the moment they are both live.

answers.explain: Neither repo can see the break. The gateway contract test asserts the new name; the console test mocks the old one, so both suites pass.
answers.fix: Land the console rename in !1509 before the gateway merges, or ship expires_at alongside expiry for one release.
answers.similar: The same pair diverged on token_id in March — see !2201.
answers.why: Field renamed on one side of a boundary that another MR in this changeset reads.

changesetSubmitPlan._comment: What one changeset triage pass posts. Each accepted item goes to the MR named by mrIid; the summary goes to every member, cross-linked to the issue. On partial failure, retry only the MRs that did not take their comments.
